content:
LivingEvent and its subclasses fire when LivingEntities take damage, die, or have their state changed. These are essential for modding combat systems, health modifiers, and death handling.

Key events:
- LivingAttackEvent: Fired when an entity attacks another (pre-damage)
- LivingDamageEvent: Fired when damage is about to be applied
- LivingHurtEvent: Fired when an entity is hurt (post-damage)
- LivingDeathEvent: Fired when an entity dies
- LivingHealEvent: Fired when an entity heals
